non_claims: The aglycone is assigned by the precursor composition hypothesis; carbocyclic iridoid versus secoiridoid skeleton is decided by the listed composition only, not by these ions.
Isomers of one aglycone formula (geniposide vs secologanin, C6/C7 epimers, oleuropein vs oleuroside) and stereochemistry are not resolved.
Sugar identity, number and linkage, and the position of a sugar-bound acyl group, are not claimed.
The C4H5O3- ion alone is not read as proof of the ester; the claim needs it jointly with the hypothesis-specific aglycone and ring-cleavage ions.

notes: Fu 2014 and Ren 2007 give hexose loss to the aglycone anion, its C4H6O3 ring-cleavage loss and C4H5O3- as C4 methyl ester marks; Wei 2022 gives the C4H6O3 loss and Abbattista 2021 the matching oleuropein ions; no floor is printed, so the 1 % default applies.

competitors.note: Free C4-acid iridoid glucosides share the hexose loss but lose CO2 and C3H4O3 instead of the methyl-ester ions (Fu 2014 summary rule 3; Ren 2007 Scheme 4).

priors.note: C4 methyl ester iridoid glucosides gave the formate adduct as main ion in formic-acid eluent, and C4 acids gave [M-H]-.
Shanzhiside methyl ester and genipin gentiobioside gave [M-H]- rather than the formate adduct.
Genipin gentiobioside (two hexoses) was characterised, so up to two hexoses are enumerated.
Hydroxycinnamoyl groups on the sugar left the aglycone ions in place, so one sugar-bound coumaroyl or sinapoyl is enumerated.
